site.name: Block Builder
site.headline: Fast, reliable plugins for Paper & Spigot servers.
site.tagline: Server software that stays out of the way — no lag spikes, no bloated configs, no surprises at 3am.
site.about: Block Builder is a solo plugin studio for Minecraft servers. I build Paper-first game systems — bounty economies, time-based SMPs, hardened GUIs — backed by crash-safe storage, validated configs and real tests. If a player can break it at 3am, the ledger still has to balance.

projects.title: BountySystem
projects.tagline: Escrowed player bounties with a full GUI — place a head, hunt it, claim the diamonds.
projects.body:
BountySystem turns any server into a bounty economy. Players escrow real value — diamonds from a chest vault or server money through Vault — place a bounty on an online player's head, and the killer claims it. Every coin moves through a crash-safe SQLite ledger, so a restart mid-payout never eats a diamond.

## Features

- **Seven-menu GUI** — board, target detail, placement flow, custom-amount book, my-bounties manager, all reachable with `/bounty`.
- **Physical escrow** — diamonds held in a chest vault, or Vault economy. What is promised is what gets paid.
- **Crash-safe ledger** — every escrow, refund and payout is an audited SQLite WAL transaction. Stuck entries can be resolved by hand.
- **Hardened menus** — identity-checked InventoryHolders, every interaction cancelled, sessions die on close or quit. The GUI never moves money itself.
- **Config that refuses to break** — the whole file is validated on load and on `/bounty reload`; an invalid edit leaves the last good config running.

## Commands

| Command | What it does | Permission |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/bounty` | Opens the bounty board GUI | `bounty.use` |
| `/bounty list` | Lists every active bounty with its id | `bounty.use` |
| `/bounty place <player> <amount>` | Escrows and places a bounty on an online player | `bounty.use` |
| `/bounty cancel <id>` | Cancels one of your bounties — an 8-character id prefix works | `bounty.use` |
| `/bounty reload` | Validates and applies a changed config | `bounty.admin` |
| `/bounty admin ledger` | Lists open ledger entries needing review | `bounty.admin` |
| `/bounty admin bounties` | Every bounty record ever stored, with status | `bounty.admin` |
| `/bounty admin resolve <id> refund\|reject` | Unsticks a ledger entry: refund pays now, reject closes it | `bounty.admin` |

Every subcommand has tab completion — online targets for `place`, your own ids for `cancel`, and the full `admin` tree for staff.

## Install

Build with `gradlew build`, take `build/libs/BountySystem-0.1.0.jar` into your `plugins/` folder, restart. First run creates `plugins/BountySystem/bounties.db` and the default config. GitHub Releases are coming soon — until then the repo is the source of truth.

Paper 26.3 · Java 25 · 58 tests

projects.title: LifeClock
projects.tagline: An SMP where every player lives on borrowed time — steal it in PvP, lose it to death, revive with a sacrifice.
projects.body:
⏳ LifeClock SMP — Time-Based Survival Plugin
Overview:

A fully customizable Paper/Spigot mechanics plugin that introduces a high-stakes time-economy system. Every player spawns with 24 hours of total survival time. The clock ticks down continuously while online, making time the ultimate currency and survival resource—the last player standing wins!

Key Technical Features:

Kill & Death Mechanics: Killing an opponent extracts a portion of their remaining time and awards it directly to the killer.

Time Withdrawal & Physical Items: Players can execute custom commands or UI actions to withdraw time into physical, tradable time tokens/items.

Custom Recipe & Unban System: When a player's timer hits zero, they are automatically eliminated/banned. Teammates can craft a custom, high-tier revival item via a specialized crafting recipe to unban fallen players.

Optimized GUI & Visual Indicators: Displays live time-trackers via clean Inventory GUIs, ActionBars, and Scoreboards using Paper's Adventure API.

Performance-First Architecture: Built with efficient scheduled tasks, custom NBT/PersistentDataContainer tags, and asynchronous data saving to prevent server lag.

Tech Stack: Java 17+, Paper/Spigot API, PersistentDataContainer, Task Scheduler, Adventure API.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `/lifeclock add <player> <time>` | Adds time to a player's clock |
| `/lifeclock remove <player> <time>` | Removes time from a player's clock |
| `/lifeclock set <player> <time>` | Sets the clock directly |
| `/lifeclock check <player>` | Shows a player's remaining time |
| `/lifeclock revive <player>` | Revives a ghost |
| `/withdraw <time>` | Withdraws time from your own clock into a Time Clock item — `/withdraw` alone opens the selection menu |

`/lifeclock` requires `lifeclock.admin` (op by default); `/withdraw` is for every player.

## Showcase

Docs, HUD states and GUI mocks live in the [life-clock-smp-website](https://github.com/vuranimation767-byte/life-clock-smp-website) repo — the plugin source is private.
